calls.label: Preflight call 1
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: God save you. What news of the parish?
calls.response:
Dia is Muire dhuit! There is great stir about this mornin'—I heard Sean Ruadh Kelly talk of secret meetin's down at the lime kiln. Da tells me I should mind the fire instead of runnin' my ears, but did ye come far along the road yourself?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes a smudged hand across his leather apron and leans forward eagerly.*

calls.label: Preflight call 2
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: How does the harvest look this year?
calls.response:
Sure, 'tis only spring yet, so there is no harvest to speak of—the men are barely finishin' plantin' the seed potatoes! Liam over at Murphy's Farm says the soil is grand and soft, le cúnamh Dé. Are ye hopin' to find work in the fields hereabouts?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes a smudge of soot from his forehead and leans forward eagerly.*

calls.label: Preflight call 3
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: Have you seen Father Declan today?
calls.response:
Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.
I haven't laid eyes on Father Declan yet this mornin', mo chara, though he is likely up at St. Brigid's Church. Da has me workin' the bellows just now, but I could dart over with a message if ye need him!
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans over the bellows handle with a grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 4
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: And how is your own family keeping?
calls.response:
We are all keepin' grand, buíochas le Dia, with Da workin' hard at the iron here and Mam keepin' us well fed! I'm growin' stronger at the bellows every day, even if Da says I've more rush than sense. Do ye have a horse needin' a shoe today?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans over the bellows handle with a bright grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 5
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?
calls.response:
I know no one by the name of Festus, nor is there any cooper's shop by a bridge in these parts! Mhuise, I run errands all across the parish for Da and know every path, but I've never heard tell of such a man. Are ye certain 'twas in this parish ye were hopin' to find him?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward over the anvil with wide eyes.*

calls.label: Preflight call 6
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: How do I get to the abbey in town?
calls.response:
There is no abbey in these parts at all, mo chara! We only have St. Brigid's Church for prayer in this parish. Were ye thinkin' of the church, mayhap?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward over the anvil with a bright grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 7
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.
calls.response:
I pump the great leather bellows till the coals glow white, and haul the iron bars across the dirt floor. When the metal is red-hot on the anvil, I strike it hard with the sledge while Da holds the tongs! Have ye ever watched an iron shoe being shaped?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face grips the handle of the bellows with a wide grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 8
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?
calls.response:
A fierce bout of hard work or runnin' the roads will cure that, for nothing puts a body to sleep quicker than tired muscles, mo chara! If 'tis a deeper trouble on yer heart, Father Declan up at St. Brigid's Church would have better words for it than a smith's lad. Would a turn at hauling iron here wear ye down enough to rest?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans eagerly over the anvil with a grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 9
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?
calls.response:
Aye, I know Padraig Darcy well enough—he keeps Darcy's Pub down the way! I run past his door all the time when Da sends me out with fresh ironwork. Are ye lookin' to find him for something, mo chara?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward with an eager grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 10
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?
calls.response:
There is no Ballyglass Castle in this parish at all, mo chara! I run every shortcut and boreen for Da, and there isn't any grand castle standing in these parts. Did someone point ye down the wrong road?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward eagerly over the dark anvil.*

calls.label: Preflight call 11
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?
calls.response:
I cannot say for certain if he is there this very minute, though Cormac is the miller and the Mill is his proper place. I've not run an errand down by the wheel yet this morning to see him with my own eyes. Are ye heading down that way with a sack of grain?
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans over the anvil with a grin.*

calls.label: Preflight call 12
calls.npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
calls.question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.
calls.response:
Aye, the hearth won't keep hot by itself and Da has a fresh bar waiting for the sledge! Slán leat, and mind the mud down the lane.
*A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face grins and grabs the wooden handle of the bellows.*

Every reply must use distinct wording — never recycle the closer of any earlier turn in the conversation, and never echo another NPC's phrasing.
